submit_reasoning: The price history shows a downtrend from ~150 to ~140 over 124 bars with no detected seasonality (strength 0.0) and no anomalies. All four context events extracted from the article (gas price surge, jet fuel spike, travel demand recovery, travel plan cancellations) were rejected by the ablation gate — the system could not map their ISO dates to bars in the price history, so they provided no additional signal. Both the history-only and event-informed runs selected the window_average model and produced identical flat forecasts of 144.681. Support is degraded (124 bars vs. 132 needed for full calibration), but this is the best available forecast. The flat 144.681 level sits between the recent recovery (~140) and the series mean (~140.3), reflecting the window average model's assessment.
